description: Answer pricing questions in USD. With just the service, return its published rate, the information needed for an estimate and a free quote link. With quantities, calculate the applicable base charge. Sourcing and supplier-site inspections need individual quotes. Use parcel for tracked delivery and orders for standalone pick-pack; the Yanwen parcel rate includes standard handling.

alreadyStoredDays.description: Days already elapsed since actual receipt of this same batch. Defaults to zero for a new batch.

batches.description: One entry per actual receiving batch, with volume and planned additional days. Use this instead of top-level storage quantities.

cubicMeters.description: Estimated stored volume in CBM, up to three decimal places; not a warehouse measurement.

inspectionLocation.description: Where the goods will be checked. Use supplier_site for a pre-shipment visit at the factory. Only standard checks at the PrepPort warehouse have a published starting rate.

months.description: Total planned duration in 30-day periods. Do not also provide storageDays.

orders.description: Number of orders for standalone first-item pick-pack. Omit if unknown. For tracked postage use parcel instead.

packedWeightGrams.description: Whole grams including packaging. Published rates cover 50–2,000 g. Other weights need an individual quote. Omit if unknown.

parcelsPerMonth.description: Monthly number of parcels with the same destination country and packed weight per parcel.

parcel.description: Tracked customer parcels. Use instead of standalone orders. Standard handling is included.

prepDeliveryUnits.description: Units per planned prep delivery, instead of units. Compare combined and separate work minimums.

sampleChecks.description: Number of agreed standard sample checks at the warehouse. For a supplier-site visit, you can give the count if known and request a separate quote.

service.description: Choose sourcing, inspection, prep, storage or fulfillment.

storageDays.description: Planned additional storage days. Prefer days for precise free-period estimates.

units.description: FBA prep units for one job. Omit if unknown. For separate deliveries use prepDeliveryUnits instead.
